functions.deepkeep_check:
return function(resp)
  local result = {
    block = true,
    block_message = "DeepKeep blocked the request",
    masked = false,
    block_reason = "invalid_response",
    block_detail = "",
  }

  if type(resp) ~= "table" or type(resp.flagged) ~= "boolean" then
    return result
  end
  if resp.flagged == false then
    result.block = false
    result.block_message = "DeepKeep allowed the request"
    result.block_reason = ""
    return result
  end
  if type(resp.verbosity) ~= "table" then
    return result
  end

  -- Require a nonempty, dense array so malformed entries cannot be skipped.
  local count = 0
  for key in pairs(resp.verbosity) do
    if type(key) ~= "number" or key < 1 or key % 1 ~= 0 then
      return result
    end
    count = count + 1
  end
  if count == 0 then
    return result
  end

  local priority = { block = 4, redact = 3, modify = 2, alert = 1 }
  local best_action = "alert"
  local best_score = 1
  local reasons = {}
  for index = 1, count do
    local item = resp.verbosity[index]
    if type(item) ~= "table" or type(item.details) ~= "table" then
      return result
    end
    local action = item.details.guardrail_action
    if type(action) ~= "string" or not priority[action] then
      action = "invalid_action"
    end
    local score = priority[action] or 5
    if score > best_score then
      best_score = score
      best_action = action
    end
    if type(item.guardrail_name) == "string" then
      table.insert(reasons, item.guardrail_name)
    end
  end

  -- No replacement content is supplied; only explicit alerts may pass.
  result.block = best_action ~= "alert"
  result.block_reason = best_action
  result.block_detail = table.concat(reasons, ", ")
  if not result.block then
    result.block_message = "DeepKeep raised an alert"
  end
  return result
end
